description: HEMM cross-language golden vectors. Frames generated with a 32-bit LCG (multiplier=1664525, increment=1013904223), reproducible bit-for-bit in Rust. Expected h_sp/h_te/h_in computed by the Python reference implementation (aura_sdk/hemm/extractor.py) after the windowed-entropy fix. Rust's aura_core::hemm::HemmWindow must match these within 1e-4 to be considered at parity.
